doc.description: Fast controller for MAV group 12 (cmjong). Receives left/middle/right loss values from MAV_cv_detect_group12_cmjong and navigates using a state machine: SAFE_AND_WAIT, TURN_TO_LOWEST_LOSS, MOVE_FORWARD_WITH_FIXED_DISTANCE, OUT_OF_BOUNDS.

define.name: MAV_cmjong_VISUAL_DETECTION_ID
define.description: Which VISUAL_DETECTION message to receive loss values from.

define.name: MAV_FAST_CONTROLLER_ENABLE_NAV_COMMANDS
define.description: Enable nav/waypoint commands from this module (set 0 when fused with MAV_plant_avoider).
